summary: Cheer Holding filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 16, 2026, Chairman/CEO/interim CFO Bing Zhang entered a Share Purchase Agreement with Hong Kong-based Lioness Limited, transferring all 500,000 Class B shares for aggregate consideration of US$500.00, roughly $0.001 per share. The Class B shares carry 100 votes each and represented about 96.44% of voting power against 1,845,453 Class A shares outstanding. Zhang cited personal and health reasons and continues in his executive roles. Watch for control-transition risk, related-party governance concerns and disclosure of the purchaser's intentions.
